content.text: Now I'll create the agent with the watcher configuration:

input.name: stock-abc
input.description: Watch inventory item barcode ABC-123 and open a refill ticket for 50 units when its stock drops below 10. Also notify me in chat when it fires.

content.text:
Done! I've created the agent **stock-abc**. Here's what it does:

- **Watches** the `current_stock` of barcode ABC-123 every 10 seconds
- **Fires** when stock crosses from ≥10 down to <10
- **Action**: Creates a refill ticket for 50 units using `testdb__create_ticket`
- **Notification**: Pushes a message back to this channel when it fires

The polling is configured to extract `current_stock` directly from the top-level response (no nested `item` object), and uses `barcode` as the entity ID so it tracks this specific item. The agent is enabled and ready to run.
